description: Only the February 3 Public Room march has an opened body with a qualitative estimate clearly above 50. description: Event-sector date claims come from an advance notice and search-only retrospective snippets rather than body-reviewed contemporaneous reporting. CIVICUS search text claims actions on February 19/22/23, while the notice lists a 14:00–17:00 schedule; execution and date details, especially E006, remain unresolved. Candidate records retain reported dates without assuming that dates alone prove separate assemblies or one continuous/recurrent campaign.
required_followup: Review contemporaneous reports for each claimed date, confirm execution and precise venues, then decide event boundaries and campaign relation from physical-action evidence; do not infer distinctness or continuity from date sequence or shared demands.

description: The opened retrospective MHC report distinguishes January 29 from the February 26 protest and reports a small violent subgroup and police obstruction of the march. The MHC report is not independent of its January reporting family.
required_followup: Check event-specific contemporaneous sources for crowd, end, police response, arrests and organizer; retain attribution and keep all January details separate.

The wedding-style report's mention of an official's presence does not alone establish accommodation.

description: The first pass searched English, Macedonian and Albanian terms and sampled weekly windows, Skopje/Tetovo/village and sector leads, local outlets, MHC and CIVICUS. It is open-web discovery rather than a systematic national press archive search, is not equivalent to LexisNexis and cannot support a claim of exhaustive coverage or no other events.
required_followup: Coordinator review should consider additional local-language/regional archives and any licensed press database available; add only source-supported records and keep coverage limits explicit.

description: The Tursko Rudare issue appears in January and again in a February 4 search lead; Monstra appears on January 29 and February 26. These are separate reported date leads, not evidence of continuous assemblies. CIVICUS snippets also mention a January 26 hospital workers protest and February 19/22/23 event-sector actions; the former may match a January lead, while boundaries among the latter remain unresolved. The shared event-sector episode key is a provisional campaign link only.
required_followup: Compare source chronology, physical end/start and organizer evidence against January and adjacent February actions; verify the possible January hospital match. Preserve separate candidate records only as date/report leads; do not merge, transfer attendance or claim event boundaries without source support and reviewer decision.
